news.title: EIC sets 19 November info day on its 2027 funding opportunities
news.summary: The online session will present Work Programme 2027 scheme by scheme, from Pathfinder to STEP Defence. Registration closes on 18 November.

news.title: CDTI Innovación commits €12.75 million to 19 R&D+I projects
news.summary: All 19 October approvals are loans. Ten companies get CDTI funding for the first time, 15 are SMEs and 13 operations are co-financed by POPE.

news.title: Open Research Europe becomes fee-free in 11 countries
news.summary: Researchers in 11 countries can now publish on the Commission's open-access platform without publication fees, under a collective funding model.

news.title: EU and Bpifrance plan €150 million guarantee for Ukraine partnerships
news.summary: The arrangement under the Ukraine Investment Framework targets French–Ukrainian industrial ties in defence and dual-use technology.

events.title: European Research and Innovation Days 2026
events.summary: The seventh edition of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, gathering policymakers, researchers, innovators, business leaders and civil society.

events.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 5 Info Day: Climate, Energy and Mobility
events.summary: A hybrid day presenting the 2027 funding topics of Cluster 5, with policy context and advice on preparing a strong proposal.

events.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 5 onsite brokerage event
events.summary: An onsite networking and brokerage session held after the Cluster 5 Info Day, from 16:00 to 19:00 at the same venue.
